title: Initialize transit binary, config loader, and async runtime
description:
Create usenet-ipfs-transit/src/main.rs. Parse TOML config (path from --config flag). Initialize tokio runtime. Wire together: IPFS client, gossipsub swarm, SQLite stores, NNTP listener. Shutdown handler: SIGTERM/SIGINT drains in-flight work then exits. Artifact: compilable transit binary that starts and stops cleanly.

Acceptance:
- cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-transit succeeds
- --config flag loads TOML file; missing file exits with clear error
- SIGTERM causes clean shutdown (all spawned tasks join within 5s)
- Startup logs: listening address, peer ID, config path
